title: REPLACE swaps a run of characters at a position for new text
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", REPLACE ( "DAX is so cool !", 11, 4, "fantastic" ) )

source.quote: REPLACE lets you replace part of a string with a new string
source.supports: the example replaces 4 characters at position 11 of "DAX is so cool !" and shows "DAX is so fantastic !"
